idea_name: WebRequest URL and JSON price scrape tutorial
mechanism: Explains URL protocol/domain/path/query, then GET WebRequest to Binance ticker/price and CoinGecko simple/price, extracting a symbol price via StringFind/StringSubstr pattern match on the JSON text.
data_needed: Allowed WebRequest URLs; symbol string; raw result char array
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, bitcoin/ethereum vs USD; spot last price (no OHLC TF)
why_new_for_mis: Language/API plumbing tutorial after full read; no regime/vol/liquidity/neural sensor.
quote: This article taught you how to use MQL5's WebRequest function and external platforms' APIs to obtain real-time price data.

idea_name: Binance klines JSON split into per-candle arrays
mechanism: GET /api/v3/klines for last 5 daily BTCUSDT candles; StringSplit on ']' then strip brackets/quotes and comma-split each candle into time/OHLC/volume fields.
why_new_for_mis: Parsing tutorial for external OHLC payloads; no sensing logic beyond data ingestion.
quote: This article showed you how to use MQL5's WebRequest function to receive candlestick data from an external platform API and how to start organizing that data.

idea_name: Group kline fields into typed OHLC arrays
mechanism: Convert ms open times to datetime (/1000) and StringToDouble OHLC/volume into OpenTime[], OpenPrice[], HighPrice[], LowPrice[], ClosePrice[] parallel arrays.
data_needed: Per-candle string arrays from prior parse
why_new_for_mis: Data-structuring lesson for API candles; no market regime or volatility sensor.
quote: In this article, we successfully took the next step in organizing API candle data by grouping similar elements from multiple daily candles into dedicated arrays.

idea_name: M30-gated Binance klines CSV bridge for indicators
mechanism: OnTick compares iTime PERIOD_M30 to last_bar_time; once per new M30 bar GET last 10 BTCUSDT 30m klines, type-convert OHLC, FileWrite CSV (Time,Open,High,Low,Close) because indicators cannot call WebRequest live.
data_needed: Binance klines; FILE_CSV handle under MQL5/Files
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSDT; interval=30m; limit=10; gated by chart PERIOD_M30
why_new_for_mis: Integration bridge/file handoff for visualization; not a sensing algorithm.
quote: indicators cannot use the WebRequest function directly in real time. With this method, we may see the API data inside MetaTrader 5 as a true chart.

idea_name: Google Generative AI WebRequest and rate-limit primer
mechanism: POST generateContent with API key, JSON body, parse "text" field, write AI_RESPONSE.txt; covers RPM/RPD/TPM limits.
why_new_for_mis: AI chat integration tutorial; no market sensing.
quote: Sending text-based queries, receiving intelligent responses, correctly formatting request bodies, parsing server responses, extracting valuable information from JSON data, and managing API limits

idea_name: CAppDialog AI control panel UI chrome
mechanism: Build chart dialog with CEdit input, CButton Send, CLabel response placeholder via Controls library; panel Create/Run/Destroy lifecycle.
why_new_for_mis: UI layout tutorial; panel not yet wired to sensing.
quote: The panel is currently completely constructed and operational; however, it is not yet linked to any backend logic or API.

idea_name: Chart-event Send button and scrollable AI label
mechanism: OnChartEvent CHARTEVENT_OBJECT_CLICK on Send posts input_box text to Gemini; substring extract AI text; OnTimer scrolls visible_text window over ai_response.
data_needed: panel controls; API key; millisecond timer
why_new_for_mis: Event/UI and LLM display plumbing; no market sensor.
quote: we explored how to make our MetaTrader 5 control panel interactive by detecting user actions and sending requests to an API.

idea_name: HMAC-SHA256 API signature construction in MQL5
mechanism: UTF-8 StringToCharArray message/key; 64-byte ipad/opad XOR; CryptEncode SHA256 inner then outer; hex encode signature for later signed requests.
why_new_for_mis: Auth/crypto tutorial only; no live market sensing.
quote: It's crucial to note that the theory and building blocks are the only topics that will be covered in this article. Sensitive information will not yet be sent in live queries.

mechanism: GET /api/v3/time, extract serverTime, HMAC-sign timestamp=, GET /api/v3/account with X-MBX-APIKEY header, save JSON balances to file.
data_needed: API key; secret key; server time; WebRequest allowlist
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Binance spot account balances (all assets); no chart TF
why_new_for_mis: Private account ops demo; balances are portfolio state not market regime/vol/liquidity sensing.
quote: we will write an MQL5 script that retrieves account balance data for every asset that is accessible by sending authenticated API queries to Binance.

idea_name: Bullish engulfing demo as order-API teaching trigger
mechanism: On new M30 bar GET last 3 Binance 30m klines, build OHLC arrays, if prior bearish and next bullish close > prior high print engulfing and POST signed MARKET BUY (educational order path).
data_needed: Binance klines OHLC; server time; API/secret keys; order params
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSDT klines interval=30m limit=3; example order symbol DOGEUSDT; gated by chart PERIOD_M30
why_new_for_mis: Series-closing API/order tutorial; classical engulfing is pedagogical chrome, not a new MIS sensor.
quote: This article is written strictly for educational purposes. All examples, projects, and demonstrations are meant to explain how MQL5 works in real-world integration scenarios.
